data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 8.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2017: GBP 10.1m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2017: predominantly from the nuclear property class).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross release of technical reserves of GBP 8.3m in respect of prior years in 2018 (a release), driven predominantly by favourable development in the nuclear property class. The release represents approximately 17.7% of the opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years are cited.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 8.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2017: GBP 10.1m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2017: predominantly from the nuclear property class).
The reduction in net incurred claims is driven by favourable prior year development of GBP 8.8m (2017: GBP 10.1m).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure taken from 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative which explicitly states a GBP 8.3m release; text does not label gross/net explicitly but is presented as a release of technical reserves (treated as gross). The Managing Agent's Report also refers to a net favourable prior year development of GBP 8.8m - that is a net (after reinsurance) figure and differs from the GBP 8.3m technical reserves release; this extract uses the GBP 8.3m technical reserves release as the primary (gross) figure. Claims development table is present (gross, in GBP 000) and has been included in _claims_triangle; the '2010 and prior' aggregate column was excluded per instructions. Mapping 'nuclear property class' to standard LOB 'Property' is an inference (confidence 0.5).
